pages.running_head: תְּפִלָּה לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה

blocks.text: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן׃
uncertainties: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה: there are several dots under ת/ח/ז. I read them as segol, hataf segol, segol, but they are crowded. Check the vowel under ז.
לְצִיּוֹן (both times): the dagesh in י is faint.
Indented paragraph at the top of the page. It continues the Avodah blessing from the previous scan.

blocks.text: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. צוּר חַיֵּינוּ מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נוֹדֶה לְךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם עִמָּנוּ וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם. הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא־כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא־תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ׃
uncertainties: שָׁאַתָּה: the mark under ש looks like qamats, as printed.
עַל חַיֵּינוּ: the first עַל has no ו, as printed.
שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם: the words are run together. The maqaf between כל and יום is unclear.
הַפְּקוּדוֹת: the dagesh in פ is faint.
לְךָ (line 3 start): I read shva under ל and qamats under final ך. There is no dagesh in ל.

blocks.text: וְעַל־כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל־בְּנֵי בְּרִיתֶךָ׃
uncertainties: בְּרִיתֶךָ: ב appears to have a dagesh, which would be unusual after בני. Confirm it under magnification (correction candidate: בְרִיתֶךָ).
Centered line, not indented.

blocks.text: וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת׃
uncertainties: וְכֹל: the holam over כ is faint and could be absent.
סֶּלָה (first): I may have misread a dagesh in ס. It is probably סֶלָה.
הָאֵל: the accent-like mark over א may be a print artifact.

blocks.text: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ.
uncertainties: There is no visible punctuation after עַמֶּךָ.
בְאוֹר (second, line start): the dagesh in ב is uncertain.
לָנוּ: possible dagesh in ל (לָּנוּ).
וְאַהֲבַת: there is a possible meteg beside the patach under א.
This paragraph ends with a period, not sof pasuq.

blocks.text: בְּסֵפֶר חַיִּים בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶיךָ אֲנַחְנוּ וְכָל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ עוֹשֵׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם׃
uncertainties: This paragraph is not indented. It continues directly after Sim Shalom.

blocks.text: אֱלֹהַי. נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה. וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה׃ פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדּוֹף נַפְשִׁי. וְכָל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם.
uncertainties: There is a sof pasuq (׃) after תִּהְיֶה in the middle of the paragraph, as printed.
תִדּוֹם: the dagesh in ת is uncertain.
וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ is spelled מצותיך with holam on the vav.
וְכָל: the qamats under כ is faint.
The page ends here. Elohai Netzor continues on the next scan (s124).

pages.running_head: Morning Prayer for the New Year

blocks.text: ותחזינה
And may our eyes behold when Thou returnest to Zion in compassion. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who restores His majesty to Zion.
מודים

We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation. We thank Thee and tell of Thy fame for our life that is delivered in Thy hand and for our souls that are entrusted to Thee and for Thy miracles that are daily with us and for Thy wonders and benefits at all times, evening, morning and noon. O Thou who art good for Thy mercies never end, O Thou who showest mercy for Thy kindnesses never cease, ever have we trusted in Thee.
ועל
For all of them may Thy Name, O our King, be continually blessed and exalted for ever and ever.
וכתוב
And inscribe for a good life all the children of Thy Covenant.
וכל

And all the living thank Thee, Selah, and praise Thy Name in truth, O God of our salvation and of our aid, Selah! Blessed art Thou, O Lord, All-benevolent, whose name is goodness and unto whom it is becoming to give thanks.
uncertainties: All-benevolent is a lexical hyphen in the middle of the line, so keep it.

blocks.text: שים

Bestow peace, good fortune, blessing, favour, grace and compassion upon us and upon all Israel Thy people. Bless us, our Father, all of us together through the light of Thy countenance, for through the light of Thy countenance hast Thou given us, O Lord our God, the Torah of life and gracious love, salvation and blessing, mercy, life and peace; and it is good in Thine eyes to bless Thy people Israel at every time and in every hour with Thy peace.
בספר

In the book of life, blessing, peace and a good livelihood, may we be remembered and inscribed before Thee, we and all Thy people the house of Israel for a good life and for peace. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who makes peace.
uncertainties: There is no comma after "O Lord", as printed (correction candidate: "O Lord, who makes peace.").

blocks.text: אלהי

My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking falsehood. Towards those who curse me, let my soul be silent and let my soul be as dust in relation to everything. Open my heart to Thy Torah and let my soul pursue Thy commandments and as for all those that devise evil against
uncertainties: The sentence breaks off mid-sentence after "against". It continues on the next scan (s125).

In the enlarged bands, s122-band1 ends where band2 begins (the line וְעַל־כֻּלָּם…) and s122-band2 ends where band3 begins (the line beginning בְּסֵפֶר). The same holds for the s123 bands. Overlapping lines are transcribed only once.
